subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should the permanent after-compaction plugin contract be only `resetSession(reason?)`, or should OpenClaw also support the unshipped explicit-session-key compatibility overload used by an external Remnic deployment?
rationale: The answer determines the public plugin API, compatibility burden, and whether an owner-scoped capability remains narrow; repository policy does not allow automation to choose a permanent plugin contract from an external fork's usage alone.

options.title: Keep only the scoped API
options.body: Expose only `resetSession("new" | "reset")` on successful, resettable after-compaction contexts and require external plugins to migrate.

options.title: Approve a deprecated compatibility overload
options.body: Keep the explicit-key form only with maintainer-approved documentation, deprecation and removal policy, current-session enforcement, and focused upgrade tests.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Remove the new plugin method until a more general session-lifecycle capability is designed and sponsored.

recommendation.title: Keep only the scoped API
recommendation.body: Expose only `resetSession("new" | "reset")` on successful, resettable after-compaction contexts and require external plugins to migrate.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available current-repository history signal ties this person to the existing compaction/reset plugin-hook contract that this PR extends.
